featured_reviews.review_text:
recently had to shift my critically ill grandfather from Jaslok Hospital in Mumbai to MGM Hospital in Jaipur, and we are extremely grateful for the exceptional service provided by the Bliss Ambulance Team throughout this challenging process.

From start to finish, the coordination, professionalism, and care shown by the entire team were truly commendable. The medical staff onboard was highly trained and ensured my grandfather’s condition remained stable throughout the long-distance transfer. They were equipped with all the necessary life-support systems and monitored him continuously, giving our family much-needed reassurance during this stressful time.

Their communication with both hospitals was seamless, and they handled every logistical detail with precision and compassion. We were especially impressed by how calm and supportive they were—not just with the patient, but with all of us as well.

Thanks to their expertise and dedication, my grandfather reached Jaipur safely and is now receiving further care at MGM Hospital. We’re deeply thankful for the positive outcome and the professionalism of the Bliss Ambulance Team. They turned a difficult situation into a smooth, well-managed experience.

Highly recommended for critical patient transfers.

Would you like a shorter or more emotional version too?
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you so much for sharing your heartfelt experience with us. We truly understand how stressful and emotional it can be to transfer a critically ill loved one over such a long distance, and it means the world to know that our team could support you and your family during this challenging time.

Your kind words about our medical staff, coordination, and care are deeply appreciated, and we’re grateful for the trust you placed in Bliss Ambulance & Medicare Services. Knowing that your grandfather reached Jaipur safely and is receiving further care brings us immense satisfaction.

We wish your grandfather a smooth recovery and your family continued strength. Thank you again for recommending us—it inspires us to keep serving families with compassion, professionalism, and dedication.

featured_reviews.name: RSC
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of attending Dr. Nariman's First Aid training the second time, and I can confidently say it was an incredibly informative and valuable experience. Dr. Nariman is highly knowledgeable and skilled in the field of First Aid, and his passion for helping others shines through in every aspect of his training.

Throughout the training, Dr. Nariman made a concerted effort to ensure that all participants felt comfortable and confident in their ability to administer First Aid in various situations. His teaching style was engaging and interactive, and he made sure to answer any and all questions thoroughly.

What impressed me most about Dr. Nariman's training was his emphasis on practical skills and real-life scenarios. He provided us with numerous opportunities to practice the skills we learned, and he offered constructive feedback and guidance every step of the way.

Ms Gloria from the admin team handles the documentations, examination and the certifications. It wasn't a very welcoming experience with her though, but she certainly can take your complain to closure.

Overall, I would highly recommend Dr. Nariman's First Aid training to anyone looking to learn valuable skills that could potentially save lives. His knowledge, expertise, and passion for helping others make him an exceptional instructor, and I feel grateful to have had the opportunity to learn from him.

featured_reviews.review_text: The best First Aid training - A life saving skill which should be taught to everyone.The syllabus is just perfect.Practical training on CPR and fracture support with a First AID book.The cost also includes tea and biscuits twice a day during training. Dr. Nariman is an excellent Trainer , I highly recommend this training to everyone.

featured_reviews.name: Preeti
featured_reviews.review_text: The first aid training is a must do. The lectures were held in a very smooth manner so that the topics are well understood. Practice sessions were efficiently conducted. Doubts and questions were well taken. The exam conducted is well designed to assure the topics are understood. Definitey recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Manali Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: It was a wonderful workshop! I think I did myself a great favour by enrolling for this course. Knowledge of first-aid is very important for all adults. The course is genuine and the contents are quite comprehensive. It was conducted by a very experienced faculty, Dr. Aspi Mehta. Every point was very clearly explained and reinforced. I am very happy to learn how to perform CPR and tying of various bandages. Besides the basics of first-aid, it has also enhanced my knowledge about the human body and various diseases. Thank you Sir, for sharing your expertise with us. The manual is also very simple and easy to understand. This two-day course gives us a good insight into first-aid but that does not guarantee that everyone who does this course will be well-equipped to give first-aid. The onus lies on us, that we build that confidence by a thorough study of the manual and practicing the procedures taught. I thank the SJA Team for this course and look forward to advanced learning courses.

featured_reviews.name: Manoj Lihe
featured_reviews.review_text: I have done 2 days training on 13th, 14th of Jan 2016, Dr. Nariman is very cool and intelligent person. I am feeling lucky that i have done my first aid training at St John, I found this knowledge useful in my personal and professional life. Thanks

Overall, a very enriching and well organized training program.

featured_reviews.review_text: Came here for BLS and ACLS training. Zen plus pvt is an AHA recognised International training center. Akshay has been helpful since day 1 till my last day. Drs Leena and Swapnil gave positive feedbacks which helped me to improve. Even though I came from Meghalaya for this course, it was worth the travel to learn under friendly, patient and knowledgeable instructors at a great place. Everything I learned was according to the latest guidelines. Applying algorithms has now become easier.
